note: Family-owned campground on all-sports Lake Nepessing with 500+ ft of shoreline, a sandy swimming beach, boat launch and docking; large sites under mature trees on rolling terrain. Propane filling. Open ~May 1-Oct 31. --Claude

flags: Price gate: the operator's posted daily rate is $85/night (full hookup, the only nightly site type; page captured 2026-02-12), well over US$50. No gateway within 40 km (Detroit 81 km); the family has not stayed here.

Mostly seasonal in character: the rates page sells every site seasonally (April 15 - October 15; lakefront sites 1-14 $3,000, off-lake 15-60 $2,800, plus electric) and by the month, week and night.
